with.defect: isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process) does not match spawn-context SpawnProcess workers, so a hung worker is not killed before its replacement starts (flusher.py:254-255).
The deadline break in join() leaves the remaining workers without termination (flusher.py:338-341).

note: Split by human review: the join() suggestions only mention the spawn-compatible type check inside their fix; a shared defect must be reported as a problem, not mentioned in the fix.

with.defect: sendAddGuestsEmails receives the raw guests array instead of the filtered uniqueGuests, so existing attendees get the wrong email template (addGuests.handler.ts:167-169).
The server schema does not enforce unique guest emails, so duplicates reach createMany (addGuests.schema.ts).

note: Split by human review: S3 only mentions the schema gap as context in its explanation; a shared defect must be reported as a problem, not cited as context or inside the fix.

with.defect: The server schema and handler never dedupe guest emails within a single request (the uniqueness refine is client-only), so createMany inserts duplicate Attendee rows.

note: Split by human review: S21 is a separate TOCTOU race between concurrent requests (different fix); S3 only cites the race as context in its WHY.

record_for_host compares lower(host) against uri.host without downcasing it, so mixed-case referers are rejected (embeddable_host.rb:14-17).
